title: Agent access
webOnly: Manage Agent access from the web server.
loadFailed: Failed to load. Please try again.
empty: Bring the Agent to your chat app
emptyHelp: Connect a Telegram bot or a Feishu app and choose the servers it may access. When someone messages the bot, approve them here to get started.

setupHelp.telegram: Receives private messages through Telegram Bot API long polling; no public callback URL is needed. The server must be able to reach Telegram.
setupHelp.feishu: Receives private messages and group @mentions over a Feishu long connection; no public callback URL is needed. The server must be able to reach open.feishu.cn.

name: Name
keepToken: Leave empty to keep the current token
tokenHelp: Open BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot, and paste the token it returns here. Credentials are encrypted and never sent back to the browser.
serversHelp: Up to 100. Approved accounts can access only these servers.
noServers: Add a server in the console first.
editStopsWork: Saving stops running tasks for this access and invalidates pending approval buttons.
deleteConfirm: Deleting stops its tasks and removes bindings, requests and delivery records. Agent session history is kept.
revokeConfirm: Revoking stops this account's tasks, invalidates unused approvals, and stops pending results from being delivered to it.

modeHelp.readonly: Allows viewing server information, monitoring and files. Shell commands and writes are blocked.
modeHelp.balanced: Allows queries; commands and file changes send approval buttons in the chat.

systemPromptPlaceholder: e.g. You are the team's on-call assistant; keep answers short. For website issues, check the nginx logs on @web-01 first.
systemPromptHelp: Type @ to reference a selected server. Changes apply from the next message.
mentionEmpty: Select servers in the Access tab first
requestHint: Once approved, this account can use the servers allowed for this access. Approve only accounts you recognize.
approved: Approved. The account has been notified.

inviteHelp.telegram: Open the bot and tap Start. The request appears here; approve it to start chatting.
inviteHelp.feishu: Send the bot any message in Feishu, or @mention it in a group. The request appears here; approve it to start chatting.

selectSession: Select a session to see the bot's conversation as it appears in the chat app.
transcriptHint: Rebuilt from what the bot actually sent; instant receipts such as "Received" are omitted
keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current App Secret

feishuSteps.create: Create a custom app and add the Bot capability
feishuSteps.scopes: In Permissions, choose Batch import and paste the scope list
feishuSteps.events: In Events & Callbacks, choose long connection and add the event and callback
feishuSteps.publish: Create and publish a version, then enter the App ID and App Secret below
